title: Cron auth fails closed outside development; throttle the vitals sink (SCAN-1124)
detail: rejectUnauthorizedCron allowed an unset CRON_SECRET anywhere NODE_ENV was not production, so a staging or self-hosted deploy ran open. It now allows only development and test. /api/vitals had no limiter; it now has one shared ceiling (never per caller, because its test pins that it never reads request headers) with whenUnconfigured allow so a missing KV cannot drop telemetry.

verify.evidence: Probe passes on this branch; unit tests added alongside (lib/net/pinned-fetch.test.ts, scripts/maintenance/live-catalog.test.ts).
